description: You will stay in a fully furnished and equipped apartment. This luxury, Parisian-style inspired apartment, warm and welcoming, will offer you the comfort of a hotel whilst giving you the feeling of being at home. The apartment is ideally situated in the centre of Paris with public transportation and a lot of popular landmarks at the doorsteps.The spaceThe apartment in particular comes with a Nespresso coffee machine, complementary high-speed WIFI internet, high-end sheets and bedding and much more!Other things to noteThe apartment is located in a residential building. Neighbors are expecting that the tranquility in and around the building is respected and noise kept to a reasonable level not only at night but also during the day. Parties are therefore strictly prohibited.
